contracts.baseline: capture_baseline_async retains its signature and starts an empty recipe from observed camera/frame/environment. Optional baseline environment_capture:{version:1,intent:...} records original declared intent separately from full observed scene.environment. Both Python and TypeScript validate the metadata and resolved catalogue; old recipes keep their previous shape.
contracts.application: Static checking admits the original declared intent or recorded resolved values, not other later edits. Seek/preview/export replay captured environment constants, while tracked scene properties supply final values directly. Recipe/session recovery preserves metadata and scientific analyses. No scientific calculation or automatic preparation is introduced.
contracts.live_review: review_rebase_async(timeout=5) uses the same observed-scene owner and returns a detached review/candidate. The latest successful review publishes one private per-view ticket only on the resumed caller after deadline/recipe/scene validation with no subsequent yield. Failed/cancelled capture preserves the previous valid review. Candidate camera/frame describe that observed moment; later navigation alone does not replace it.
contracts.acceptance: Existing rebase(review) accepts an unchanged regenerated live report against the private observation and current scene/science. It preserves every track/key and sends no scene commands. Headless review_rebase remains independent of renderer tickets. Tickets are consumed/superseded by recipe replacement, a new successful live review, molecular projection/reset or close; accepted baseline metadata persists, tickets do not. Molecular invalidation releases the observation reference instead of retaining a replaced system.
